final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT sf.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(sf.anlycount) AS avg_anly FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON sf.trdref2 = t.tradereg GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.transref, s1.tradekind, s1.avg_anly, s1.avg_anly - s2.overall_avg AS diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_anly > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT s3.tradekind, AVG(s3.avg_anly) AS avg_avg_anly, AVG(s3.diff) AS avg_diff FROM step3 s3 GROUP BY s3.tradekind), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(s4.avg_avg_anly) AS final_avg FROM step4 s4) SELECT s4.tradekind, s4.avg_avg_anly, s4.avg_diff, s4.avg_avg_anly / s5.final_avg AS ratio FROM step4 s4 CROSS JOIN step5 s5 WHERE s5.final_avg IS NOT NULL
